title: Constant-coefficient derived direct image preserves local completeness
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal E$ be small sites, let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal. Let $L\dashv V$ be an adjunction of their topoi with $L$ preserving finite limits, and $F$ its coherent inverse-image datum [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Suppose the ordinary constant-coefficient module pullback is exact with additive right adjoint $G$. Let $RG$ with comparison $\eta$ be its universal complex-level total right derived functor, with $\eta_J$ invertible on K-injective representatives. If $N\in D(\mathcal E,\underline A)$ is locally derived $I$-complete, then $RG(N)\in D(\mathcal C,\underline A)$ is locally derived $I$-complete. Here local completeness means [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete] for the actual kernel ideal of $\underline A\to\underline{A/I}$, as defined in [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence].

proof.text: The constant quotient kernel is generated by constants from I. The complete-elements ideal theorem and local completeness model comparison reduce target completeness to tests at every a in I. On the source, the transported section beta_a lies in the quotient kernel by [lem-sp-constant-inverse-image-section], so N is complete for beta_a. Apply [lem-sp-constant-scalar-direct-image-completeness] to obtain completeness for a on the target, and use the generating-ideal criterion in reverse.

theorem constantDirectImage_preservesComplete
    {C E : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory E]
    (JC : GrothendieckTopology C) (JD : GrothendieckTopology E)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {L : Sheaf JC (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type u)}
    (V : Sheaf JD (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type u)) (adj : L ⊣ V)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] (F : InverseImageData L)
    (G : Mod (constant JD A) ⥤+ Mod (constant JC A))
    (aM : pull F (constantMap F A) ⊣ G.obj)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (pull F (constantMap F A))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (pull F (constantMap F A))]
    (RF : D (constant JD A) ⥤ D (constant JC A))
    (ηG : G.obj.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ Q (constant JC A) ⟶
      Q (constant JD A) ⋙ RF)
    (hRF : RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor ηG
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (Mod (constant JD A)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hηG : ∀ J : Cx (constant JD A), J.IsKInjective → IsIso (ηG.app J)) :
    ∀ N : D (constant JD A), IsComplete (quotient JD A I 0) N →
      IsComplete (quotient JC A I 0) (RF.obj N)
